en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of colonial soldiers with bicycles resting along a dirt road lined with tall palm trees. The men wear tropical helmets and military uniforms and are lying or sitting beside their bicycles under the shade of the palms. At the top appears a printed header from the Belgian Ministry of Colonies, and in the bottom-right corner there is an official stamp indicating authorization for publication. The caption at the bottom left identifies the scene as cyclists at rest.
